Kerala High Court Orders New Ritual Layout Plan

The Kerala High Court has directed authorities to create a new layout plan for the Balitharpanam ritual, also known as Karkidaka Vavu Bali, at Thirumullavaram beach. The court's order aims to improve crowd management during the annual event. The directive focuses on ensuring a better arrangement for the ritual which draws a significant number of devotees.
